<head>
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      var form = document.querySelector('form'); // החלף לבורר שמתאים לטופס שלך
      if (!form) return;

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault(); // מניעת שליחה רגילה, רק לצורך הדוגמה

        // איסוף נתוני הטופס
        var emailInput = document.querySelector('input[name="אימייל"]');
        var phoneInput = document.querySelector('input[name="טלפון"]');

        var email = emailInput ? emailInput.value.trim() : "";
        var phone = phoneInput ? phoneInput.value.trim() : "";

        // הצפנת הנתונים בפורמט SHA256
        function hashData(data) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            try {
              var encoder = new TextEncoder();
              var dataBuffer = encoder.encode(data);
              crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', dataBuffer)
                .then(function (hashBuffer) {
                  var hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
                  var hashHex = hashArray.map(function (byte) {
                    return byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
                  }).join('');
                  resolve(hashHex);
                })
                .catch(reject);
            } catch (error) {
              reject(error);
            }
          });
        }

        // שליחה ל-Google לאחר הצפנה
        Promise.all([hashData(email), hashData(phone)]).then(function (hashedValues) {
          var hashedEmail = hashedValues[0];
          var hashedPhone = hashedValues[1];

          gtag('event', 'conversion', {
            'send_to': 'AW-857887019/au1GCOzM27EDEKuiiZkD', // מזהה המרה ותווית המרה
            'email': hashedEmail,
            'phone_number': hashedPhone
          });

          // לאחר השליחה, אפשר לשלוח את הטופס כרגיל
          form.submit();
        }).catch(function (error) {
          console.error('Error hashing data:', error);
        });
      });
    });
  </script>
</head>

<script>
(function () {
  function pickValue(selectors) {
    for (var i = 0; i < selectors.length; i++) {
      var el = document.querySelector(selectors[i]);
      if (el && typeof el.value === "string" && el.value.trim()) return el.value.trim();
    }
    return "";
  }

  function normalizePhone(phoneRaw) {
    var phone = (phoneRaw || "").replace(/[^\d+]/g, "").trim();
    // Israel normalization: 05X... / 0X...  -> +972...
    if (/^0\d{8,9}$/.test(phone)) phone = "+972" + phone.substring(1);
    return phone;
  }

  function saveECValues() {
    // First name (try common patterns + Hebrew placeholders)
    var firstName = pickValue([
      'input[name="firstname"]',
      'input[name="first_name"]',
      'input[name*="first" i]',
      'input[id*="first" i]',
      'input[placeholder*="שם פרטי"]',
      'input[aria-label*="שם פרטי"]'
    ]);

    // Last name (try common patterns + Hebrew placeholders)
    var lastName = pickValue([
      'input[name="lastname"]',
      'input[name="last_name"]',
      'input[name*="last" i]',
      'input[id*="last" i]',
      'input[placeholder*="שם משפחה"]',
      'input[aria-label*="שם משפחה"]'
    ]);

    // Phone (your confirmed selector first!)
    var phoneRaw = pickValue([
      '#phoneNumber',                 // ✅ your site
      'input[name*="phone" i]',
      'input[id*="phone" i]',
      'input[class*="phone" i]',
      'input[placeholder*="טלפון"]',
      'input[placeholder*="נייד"]',
      'input[aria-label*="טלפון"]',
      'input[maxlength="10"]',
      'input[maxlength="11"]'
    ]);

    var phone = normalizePhone(phoneRaw);

    // Only store if phone exists (prevents junk storage)
    if (!phone) return;

    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem("ec_firstname", firstName);
      sessionStorage.setItem("ec_lastname", lastName);
      sessionStorage.setItem("ec_phone", phone);

      // unique id to help avoid duplicates
      if (!sessionStorage.getItem("ec_event_id")) {
        sessionStorage.setItem(
          "ec_event_id",
          String(Date.now()) + "_" + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Most reliable: save on typing / changes (works even with fast redirect / custom submit)
  document.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function (e) {
      if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) {
        saveECValues();
      }
    },
    true
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    "change",
    function (e) {
      if (
        e.target &&
        (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || e.target.tagName === "SELECT")
      ) {
        saveECValues();
      }
    },
    true
  );

  // Bonus: also save on submit/click
  document.addEventListener(
    "submit",
    function () {
      saveECValues();
    },
    true
  );

  document.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function (e) {
      var btn = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('button, input[type="submit"], a') : null;
      if (btn) saveECValues();
    },
    true
  );
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  try {
    var phone = sessionStorage.getItem("ec_phone") || "";
    var firstName = sessionStorage.getItem("ec_firstname") || "";
    var lastName = sessionStorage.getItem("ec_lastname") || "";
    var eventId = sessionStorage.getItem("ec_event_id") || "";

    if (!phone) return;

    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: "ec_user_data_ready",
      user_data: {
        phone_number: phone,
        first_name: firstName,
        last_name: lastName
      },
      ec_event_id: eventId
    });

  } catch(e) {}
})();
  setTimeout(function(){
  sessionStorage.removeItem("ec_phone");
  sessionStorage.removeItem("ec_firstname");
  sessionStorage.removeItem("ec_lastname");
  sessionStorage.removeItem("ec_event_id");
}, 3000);
</script>
